scheme_name: Biju Patnaik Sports Award for Best Contribution to promotion of Sports and Games
other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Odisha or have stayed in Odisha for at least 7 years
Applicant must not have been convicted of any criminal offence
An individual can receive the award only once in their lifetime
The award may be given posthumously to the next of kin of the awardee

Organization must have substantially contributed by recruiting sportspersons, providing financial support for advanced coaching and international participation, and sponsoring national/international sporting events
Award may be cancelled and recovered if obtained by fraudulent means
benefits_summary: The award includes a cash prize of ₹1,00,000 together with a statue, scroll of honor, blazer, tie and travel allowance as per Grade A officer rates.
